localCmakeInclude.contents:
# Local host GCC14 workaround for unchanged pinned RN Utf8.h:37.
# Repository native targets keep -Werror=sign-compare.
if(PROJECT_NAME STREQUAL "react-native-qnx")
  function(rnqnx_local_upstream_return_warning directory)
    get_property(children DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY SUBDIRECTORIES)
    foreach(child IN LISTS children)
      rnqnx_local_upstream_return_warning("${child}")
    endforeach()
    if(directory MATCHES "/node_modules/react-native/")
      get_property(targets DIRECTORY "${directory}" PROPERTY BUILDSYSTEM_TARGETS)
      foreach(target IN LISTS targets)
        get_target_property(kind "${target}" TYPE)
        if(NOT kind STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY" AND NOT kind STREQUAL "UTILITY")
          target_compile_options("${target}" PRIVATE -Wno-error=return-type -Wno-error=changes-meaning)
        endif()
      endforeach()
    endif()
  endfunction()
  function(rnqnx_local_gcc_workaround)
    rnqnx_local_upstream_return_warning("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
    if(TARGET jsinspector)
      target_compile_options(jsinspector PRIVATE -Wno-error=sign-compare -Wno-error=pessimizing-move)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_mapbuffer)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_mapbuffer PRIVATE -Wno-error=sign-compare)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_core)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_core PRIVATE -Wno-error=return-type -Wno-error=changes-meaning)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_cxxreact)
      target_compile_options(react_cxxreact PRIVATE -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations -Wno-error=class-memaccess -Wno-error=sign-compare)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_uimanager)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_uimanager PRIVATE -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations -Wno-error=sign-compare)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_animationbackend)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_animationbackend PRIVATE -Wno-error=parentheses)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_animated)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_animated PRIVATE -Wno-error=sign-compare)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_renderer_observers_intersection)
      target_compile_options(react_renderer_observers_intersection PRIVATE -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations)
    endif()
    if(TARGET react_nativemodule_core)
      target_compile_options(react_nativemodule_core PRIVATE -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations)
    endif()
    if(TARGET rrc_native)
      target_compile_options(rrc_native PRIVATE -Wno-error=pessimizing-move)
    endif()
  endfunction()
  cmake_language(DEFER CALL rnqnx_local_gcc_workaround)
endif()

limits: QNX and Marathon refer to the real public JavaScript identities bundled for each target. Both native executions use the Linux Qt offscreen host, not a QNX Screen or Marathon Wayland device.
Activation changes, contrast signals and key events are injected through real public Qt APIs for deterministic tests; no operating-system setting or physical keyboard is exercised.
Announcements are observed at Qt delivery; no screen-reader speech or announcement completion is established.

Registered accessibility actions and mapped roles are proven only within the tested contract. A role does not add an arbitrary numeric value setter, editable text implementation, table model or selection model.

ASan leak detection is disabled. Instrumentation covers only the explicitly instrumented platform-services runtime and QtQuickMountingLayer test executables; it is not complete library instrumentation.
The historical accessibility regression suite predates the final source and contains the retained RN LeakChecker remount diagnostic.
The provider-disabled local configuration retains desktop input ON. It does not replace the independent hosted all-options-OFF matrix.
All native feature flags retain their default OFF values.
